page.layout: One printed page: a column of page references at the left, separated by a vertical rule from a column of bibliographic entries (Latin, Arabic, with some Arabic script). Under the last entry, at the right, a catchword.

main_text.l: p.87. | Medicus quidam ] scil. author libri شامل.
p.91. & 95. | Mostatraf ] nomen libri est المستطرف من كل فن مستطرف authore incerto.
p.98. | Mohammed Ebn Abdollahi ] ابو عبد الله محمد بن عبد الله بن عمرو
Abu Abdul'lah Mohammed Ebn Abdillah Ebn Amri. author libri aftronomici dicti كتاب البيان يواقيت البرهان sive كتاب التبيان [?] Camel.
p.96. & 98. | Ali Ebnol Athir ] ابو الحسن علي بن ابي الكرم محمد بن عبد الكريم الشيباني المعروف
بابن الاثير الجزري الملقب عزالدين AbulHafan Ali Ebn AbilCaram Mohammed Ebn AbdilCarim AlShaibani, notus nomine Ebnol Athir AlJazari,

cognominatus EZZoddin. frater AlMobaraci Ebnol Athwi, natus in جزيرة ابن عمر anno H. 555. mortuus an. 630. historiam كامل inscriptam, ab origine mundi usque ad finem anni H. 628. perduxit. Ebnol Chalec.
p.104. | Ali Makrizius ] تقي الدين احمد بن علي
Takioddin Ahmed Ebn Ali, vul. يعرف بالمقريزي dictus Al Makrizi. Natus, ut ipse in hist. testatur post annum H. 760. (scil. teste Jalaloddino 769.) mortuus 840.
p.108. | Liber نظم الدر Nodh mol'dorr. Epitome libri ذكر الدر Nothrol dorr, seu excepta ex eo continens.
p.116. | Liber خريدة العجايب Charidatol Ajaeb ] author est ابن الوردي EbnolWardi quidam.

page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew-type script is only partly legible at this scan resolution; words marked [?] are approximate, and the Arabic lines in the entries for Mohammed Ebn Abdollahi and Ali Ebnol Athir are the least certain. Long s has been rendered as s. The page references in the left column are aligned with the entries and kept on the same line as each entry. The catchword is at the lower right and is doubtful. No running head or other furniture is printed.
